_doc: ENGINE_SEEDS: the seeded graph rules the world loads into its making engine, in load order (scenario seeds are loaded after these). RESIDENT_SEEDS: the seeded rules every resident's own mind loads for choosing and speaking (loaded in this order). RESIDENT_CONCEPT_SEEDS: the speech-act vocabulary a resident's mind holds. Each id names a seed file in seeds/ or bigville/seeds/ (checked by the self-test). Loading a seed records its id; the seed rules are not executed here.
